controls.zh: 《Bandit》现为多人版《Vault Breakers》。金库模式至少需要两人，可创建或加入房间。原作支持键鼠和标准手柄。
controls.en: Bandit is now Vault Breakers. Heist needs at least two players. Create or join a room. Play with keyboard and mouse or a standard gamepad.

objective.zh: 在劫案模式中，逃脱者要在倒计时结束前将钻石送到撤离点。破坏者负责藏起钻石、守住屋子。
objective.en: In Heist, runners deliver diamonds to the getaway before time runs out. The saboteur hides the diamonds and defends the house.

steps.zh: 从 PLAY 进入，选 CREATE ROOM 建房，把房间码给同伴。另一位玩家选 JOIN BY CODE 输入房间码。
steps.en: Choose PLAY, then CREATE ROOM and share the room code. A second player can enter it under JOIN BY CODE.

steps.zh: 选 HEIST，至少两人入房。所有人选 READY 后，由房主开始。每轮先看分配给自己的角色。
steps.en: Select HEIST with at least two players. Everyone readies up, then the host starts. Check your role each round.

steps.zh: 逃脱者靠近家具长按 E 搜寻，找到钻石后送到 GETAWAY。用方向键移动，Shift 冲刺。标准手柄用摇杆移动、A 互动、RT 冲刺。
steps.en: As a runner, hold E beside furniture to search it and bring diamonds to GETAWAY. Use the arrows to move and Shift to sprint. On a standard gamepad use the stick, A and RT respectively to move, interact and sprint.

controls.zh: 点鱼车，把车尾相连的同色鱼放进环形管道。鱼会自动进入车尾同色且有空位的车，没有匹配的车时可进入空车。
controls.en: Click or tap a bus to send its tail group of same-colour fish into the pipe. Fish board buses with a matching tail and room. If none match, they can enter an empty bus.

objective.zh: 把鱼按颜色装车。管道里的鱼全部上车、每辆有鱼的车都装满同一种颜色，即可过关。
objective.en: Sort the fish by colour. Clear the pipe and fill each occupied bus with fish of a single colour.

steps.zh: 观察各车最靠近出口的鱼。点一辆车，车尾相连的同色鱼会一起进入管道。
steps.en: Look at the fish nearest each bus exit. Tap a bus to send its tail group of matching fish into the pipe.

steps.zh: 留意哪辆车还有空位，鱼会自动进入车尾同色的车；没有匹配车时可进入空车。
steps.en: Watch for free spaces. A fish boards a bus whose tail matches its colour, or an empty bus when there is no match.

steps.zh: 结算后选 Màn tiếp 进入下一关，选 Chơi lại 重试。齿轮按钮打开设置，选 Tiếp tục 返回关卡。
steps.en: Choose Màn tiếp after a win to advance, or Chơi lại to retry. The gear opens settings and Tiếp tục resumes the level.

terms.label: Không còn cá nào vào được xe
terms.en: No fish can board a bus

controls.zh: 在「NOIR CITY」标题页开始，进入《NOIR EXTREME》第一章餐馆。WASD 移动、鼠标观察、E 交互。支持标准手柄。
controls.en: Start from the NOIR CITY title screen to enter the original NOIR EXTREME diner chapter. Move with WASD, look with the mouse and interact with E. Standard gamepads are supported.

objective.zh: 跟随餐馆第一章的线索。画面左上角给出当前目标，视线对准可互动物件时，下方会出现按键提示。
objective.en: Follow the clues in the diner chapter. Your current objective appears at the upper left. Look at an interactive object to see its button prompt.

steps.zh: 在 NOIR CITY 标题页选 BEGIN，本入口会直接从 The Diner 的柜台开局。坐在高脚凳上时，先用鼠标或右摇杆环顾四周。
steps.en: Choose BEGIN on the NOIR CITY title screen. This entry opens The Diner at the counter. While seated, use the mouse or right stick to look around.

steps.zh: 将视线移向柜台上的物件，看到 E 再按下，依次完成点烟、点酒、喝酒和付账。标准手柄用方块键互动。
steps.en: Look at objects on the counter. When E appears, press it to light up, order a drink, drink it or pay. Use the Square button on a PlayStation-style controller.

steps.zh: 可以步行时，用 WASD 或左摇杆移动。按 Esc 可暂停并释放鼠标，再回到指南。
steps.en: Once you are on foot, walk with WASD or the left stick. Esc pauses and releases the pointer so you can open the guide.

terms.label: The Diner
terms.en: The opening chapter at the counter

terms.label: E
terms.zh: 与视线对准的物件互动

terms.label: Light up.
terms.zh: 点烟。视线移到打火机出现提示后，按互动键。
terms.en: Light your cigarette. Look at the lighter and use it when prompted.

terms.label: Order a drink.
terms.zh: 点酒。等服务员靠近，看到 scotch 时互动。
terms.en: Order a drink. Wait for the server, then respond to the scotch prompt.

terms.label: Drink. Watch the big man.
terms.zh: 喝酒，留意那个大块头。出现 drink 时可喝一口。
terms.en: Sip when drink appears and watch the big man.

terms.label: Pay the tab.
terms.zh: 结账。看到 pay 提示时按互动键。
terms.en: Pay the bill when the pay prompt appears.

controls.zh: 方向键或 WASD 驾驶，S 爬升，W 俯冲。空格喷漆，长按蓄力，E、Q 换挡。
controls.en: Steer with the arrows or WASD. S climbs and W dives. Press or hold Space to paint, and shift gears with E or Q.

objective.zh: 驾驶会飞的校车游览旧金山。靠近屋顶喷出彩漆，可以把灰色建筑染上颜色。
objective.en: Fly the school bus around San Francisco and paint the grey buildings as you pass over their roofs.

steps.zh: 巴士在地图加载后自动飞行。用左右方向键转弯，下键拉升，上键俯冲。初次转弯可先用 Q 降挡。
steps.en: The bus flies automatically once the map loads. Steer with Left and Right, pull up with Down and dive with Up. Q shifts down for a slower turn.

steps.zh: 轻按空格喷彩，按住空格蓄力，松开喷出更大的彩团。E 升挡，Q 降挡，Esc 打开设置。
steps.en: Tap Space to splat, or hold it to charge and release for a bigger blast. E shifts up, Q shifts down and Esc opens settings.

steps.zh: 用触屏时，默认在屏幕右侧拖动可转向，向下拖爬升。轻点 MEGA 喷彩，按住可蓄力。
steps.en: On touchscreens, drag on the right to steer in the default layout. Drag down to climb. Tap MEGA to paint or hold it to charge.

controls.zh: 选标题页第一项开始、续玩或重玩，再选「ROW OUT」出航。移动指针划船，靠近微光收集。点击或按空格放出灯火，Esc 回岸。
controls.en: Choose the first title-menu option to start, continue or replay, then ROW OUT. Move the pointer to row near wisps and collect them. Click or press Space to flare. Esc returns to shore.

objective.zh: 在黎明前划船收集足够的微光，点亮当夜的灯塔。五个夜晚各有自己的目标。
objective.en: Row out and gather enough wisps to light the beacon before dawn. Each of the five nights has its own quota.

steps.zh: 标题页第一项是五夜航程。初玩选 BEGIN THE NIGHTS，有存档时这里会显示续玩的夜次。看完简报后选 ROW OUT。
steps.en: The first title option opens the five nights. It reads BEGIN THE NIGHTS on a fresh save or names the next night on a returning save. Read the briefing and choose ROW OUT.

steps.zh: 用鼠标移动或手指拖动带领小船靠近微光。正上方的 DAWN 是剩余时间，左侧数字是当前收集量和目标。
steps.en: Move the pointer or drag to guide the boat near wisps. DAWN shows the time left, while the counter on the left tracks your quota.

steps.zh: 灯火充好后，点击或按空格释放，驱走暗流并吸引微光。连续收集可加快充能。Esc 会放弃当夜航行并回岸。
steps.en: When charged, click or press Space to flare, repel the Undertow and draw wisps closer. Collecting wisps in quick succession charges the flare faster. Esc abandons the current night.

zh: 大田都市科学高中专业探索
en: Daejeon Urban Science High School Department Tour

controls.zh: 选「입장하기」参观学校，「미니게임」体验小游戏。点击、空格或回车推进韩语对白，选「시작」开始小游戏。
controls.en: Choose 입장하기 for the campus tour or 미니게임 for minigames. Click, press Space or Enter to advance Korean dialogue. 시작 starts the selected minigame.

objective.zh: 参观学校的各个专业，或从菜单中选择六款专业体验小游戏。糕点项目需要按顾客的图样做蛋糕。
objective.en: Explore the school’s departments or choose one of six minigames. In the pastry game, match each cake to a customer’s pictured order.

steps.zh: 从首页选 입장하기 进入校园。点击、空格或回车可推进对白。要直接体验小游戏，选 미니게임。
steps.en: Choose 입장하기 to visit the campus. Click, press Space or press Enter to advance dialogue. Choose 미니게임 to go directly to the minigames.

steps.zh: 在糕点游戏中选 시작 开始。先看顾客气泡中的蛋糕，从下往上依次选蛋糕胚、奶油、装饰。
steps.en: Choose 시작 to start the cake game. Read the customer’s picture from bottom to top and select the cake base, cream and topping.

steps.zh: 点击配料或用数字键。1 巧克力胚、2 香草胚；3 鲜奶油、4 草莓奶油；5 草莓、6 蓝莓、7 巧克力。三层选齐后会自动交单。
steps.en: Tap ingredients or use number keys. 1 and 2 select chocolate or vanilla base, 3 and 4 plain or strawberry cream, and 5–7 strawberry, blueberry or chocolate topping. Selecting all three layers submits the order.

terms.label: 케이크 타이쿤
terms.zh: 蛋糕店。照顾客的图样配料，经营 45 秒。
terms.en: Cake shop. Match the pictured orders and keep the shop running for 45 seconds.

terms.label: 도로 주행 테스트
terms.zh: 道路试驾。点左右换车道，避开障碍，坚持 30 秒。
terms.en: Road test. Tap left or right to change lanes and avoid obstacles for 30 seconds.

terms.label: BMS 충전 관리
terms.zh: 电池管理。在电量到达绿色区间（80%–95%）时点对应电池，防止过充。
terms.en: Battery management. Tap each cell in the green zone (80–95%) to stop charging.

terms.label: 금 간 타일 교체
terms.zh: 更换裂砖。及时点裂开的瓷砖，换好十块即可过关。
terms.en: Tile repair. Tap the cracked tiles in time to replace ten of them.

terms.label: 드론 측량 비행
terms.zh: 无人机测绘。按住上升，松开下降，绕开障碍后缓缓降落。
terms.en: Drone survey. Hold to climb and release to descend. Avoid obstacles, then land gently.

terms.label: 무전기 정비 순서
terms.zh: 维修对讲机。记住指示灯顺序，依序按键，完成三轮。
terms.en: Radio repair. Repeat the sequence of lights for three rounds.
